subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

In humans, lack of sleep leads to ______ memory and reduced cognitive abilities.
solution:
The correct answer is:** impaired**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate word to fill in the blank is "impaired."
 
• The word "impaired" fits the blank because it means weakened, damaged, or diminished.
 
• In the context of the sentence, it indicates that lack of sleep leads to "impaired" memory and reduced cognitive abilities in humans.
 
• When individuals do not get enough sleep, their ability to remember and process information can be negatively affected, resulting in impaired memory and reduced cognitive functioning.

Therefore, the correct answer is: In humans, lack of sleep leads to ***impaired***__ memory and reduced cognitive abilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Now, let's provide the meanings of all the options along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Attended: **Past tense of the verb "attend," which means to be present at or go to an event, meeting, or function. (उपस्थित होना)
 
• **Impaired: **Weakened, damaged, or diminished. (हानित, कमजोर)
 
• **Thankless:** Lacking appreciation or gratitude. (अवज्ञाकारी)
 
• **Witnessed: **Past tense of the verb "witness," which means to see or observe an event, situation, or occurrence. (गवाही देना)
